newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Fesilven raises output, narrows losses.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Fesilven raises output, narrows losses.

text.p: Venezuela's state-owned ferro- silica producer Fesilven, due to be privatized early next year, boosted its output by 33 percent to 67,204 tonnes in 1996 compared to 50,389 tonnes in 1995, according to official figures obtained by Reuters.

At the same time, Fesilven forecast that it has narrowed its net losses to an estimated 4.769 billion bolivars for this year from a 10.142 billion bolivar loss in 1995, the table of figures produced by state holding Corporacion Venezolana de Guayana (CVG) showed.
The increase in output came despite a small reduction in personnel to 11,452 in 1996 from 11,952 in 1995.
Founded in 1973, Fesilven has three ovens that produced about three percent of the world's ferro-silica in 1995. Ninety percent of output is exported.
Qualified bidders for the privatization of Fesilven are expected to be announced on December 13.
